item.title: Pre-session Joint Legislative Luncheon kicks off series
More than a marketplace: The evolution of the G&S Gun Show
item.description: SHAWNEE, OK – For most attendees, a gun show is a place to browse rows of steel and wood, but for G&S Promotions organizer Stephanie Ellis, the upcoming event at the Heart of Oklahoma Expo Center is more of a family reunion. As trailers roll into Shawnee later this week, they bring more than just inventory; they bring a traveling community of collectors and craftsmen who have converged here for years.

item.title: Shawnee girls, boys smash Tulsa Will Rogers in road contests
item.description: TULSA – The Shawnee Lady Wolves and Wolves claimed two easy road victories over Tulsa Will Rogers Tuesday night with a 51-19 rout in the girls’ game and 77-50 hammering in the boys’ contest.

item.title: January brings tornadoes, snow and arctic cold
item.description: January 2026 delivered a little bit of everything Oklahoma weather is known for — a rare January tornado outbreak, a major winter storm accompanied by arctic cold, and continued drought across much of the state. The month featured both destructive severe weather and prolonged freezing conditions, including one of the most impactful snow and ice events in recent memory.

item.title: SLT's heartfelt romantic comedy 'Outside Mullingar' opens Feb. 13
item.description: Shawnee Little Theatre’s next offering, “Outside Mullingar” arrives onstage just in time for Valentine’s Day to explore the hope that it’s never too late to take a chance on love. Set in rural Ireland, “Outside Mullingar” explores the complicated relationship between Anthony and Rosemary, their families, and their shared history and property.
